annotations.text:
LIQUOR-LOG — thirteen screens, warm gold on brown-black.

Newsreader for bottle names, Public Sans for everything else, Spline Sans Mono for batch codes and proof. Nothing under 12px; body text is 16px.

Screen 10, the bourbon wheel, is LIVE — tap a family, tap descriptors, switch between Nose / Entry / Mid / Finish and watch the picks attach to that stage. Everything else is a static mockup.

Every number is an engine value: 13 of 17 pours is 573 ml is 76%, and $79.99 over 17 pours is $4.71.

FOUNDATION

Both palettes, the semantic roles, all six verdict badges, the type ramp and the spacing rhythm.

Owned states are filled; states you do not own are outlined. The fill is what carries at arm's length in a shop aisle.

SHELF CHECK — four screens

Screen 3 is the one that matters: one query, three different answers. ON YOUR SHELF, TASTED NOT OWNED, HAVE THE LINE.

Your reference badged the Small Batch as HAVE THE LINE while its own caption said tasted at a bar. Those are two different verdicts, so I kept the engine-correct one.

BOTTLE DETAIL — three screens

Class type and production type are always two separate rows. Kentucky Straight is one fact; small batch is another.

Screen 7 decodes OESQ from the four letters on the label. Screen 8 bands the oxidation estimate and says in the card that it is a rule of thumb, never a date.

TASTING — three screens

The wheel feeds the tasting. Each stage on screen 9 shows the descriptors picked for it, and the Wheel chip opens screen 10.

Screen 10 is interactive: eight bourbon families, tap through to descriptors, and the hub counts what is on the current stage.

COLLECTION & LISTS — two screens

The collection counts bottles owned, never drinks had — Apple rejects apps that encourage excessive consumption, which rules out streaks and volume counters.

Beer sits in the same collection and answers a different question: Bourbon County cellars well, so the app says so rather than nagging.

LIGHT MODE — the same components, the same layout, only the tokens flip.

Gold becomes a deeper bronze so it holds contrast on cream, and the verdict colours darken to stay legible. Four screens shown rather than all thirteen, since nothing about the structure changes.
